candidates.title: XTracker exact Elon Musk July 25-27 post records
candidates.description: Public JSON post records for one exact user, platform, and UTC interval.
candidates.why_relevant: Per-post creation and tracker-import times can support conservative historical post-count and pace features for the matching development event.
candidates.temporal_coverage: Exact requested interval; verify from acquired records and tracking metadata.
candidates.frequency: Event records with per-post timestamps; tracker polling cadence is not contractually guaranteed.
candidates.license: Public API terms not stated in the documentation; retain only for reproducible research audit.
candidates.access_notes: Unauthenticated documented public GET endpoint; UTC bounds used without timezone=EST because offset-bearing timezone queries shifted the observed interval.
risks: historical deletions and revisions are not exposed
import polling delay varies and must be used as availability
single-event evidence does not establish generality
